citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.97，dader- 條下派生詞

records.text: mudader bazeng alaw di bakung lia ki rakihan

senses.en: The child got choked with a fish bone in his throat.

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.97，dader- 條下派生詞

records.text: haaw lia padader di namisiw a sungut namisiw a xinutu a batu lai ki alaw a isia

senses.zh: 這魚給橋下的石堆給困住了
senses.en: The fish was hooked by the piled stones under the bridge.
The child got caught in the vine.

records.text: padader di bakung lia ki bazeng alaw

senses.en: The fish bone got caught in the throat.

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.97，dadi- 條下派生詞

senses.zh: 古床物之上之框架（可掛蚊帳），掛衣床架

senses.en: plant sp.,whose small seeds stick easily to clothes
to try to reach above by hand

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.97，daeh- 條下派生詞

senses.en: is trying to reach high above by hand

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.97，daeh- 條下派生詞
《巴宰語詞典》p.97，dahin- 條下派生詞

records.text: dahu a saw di nimisiw a xuma lia

senses.en: Many people went to his house.

records.text: makuas namisiw ina tia didua malaleng; dahu a kakanen

senses.zh: （他）告訴他媽媽到那邊去住，（那兒有）很多好吃的
senses.en: (The boy) told his mother to move there to live; (there was) plenty to eat.

records.text: ludug a kinixidan dahu a sabun, hayayay, xasi, rabex a hayayay

senses.zh: 在潭邊有許多青草，細茅、粗茅、嫩茅草
senses.en: There are plenty of grass, miscanthus and bud near the pond.

citation.label: 《巴宰語詞典》p.97–98，dahu- 條下派生詞
《巴宰語詞典》p.97–98，dahu- 條下派生詞

records.text: mahaki tumala mikita ka pakadahu, makawas ka pakatatingen

senses.zh: 似乎聽得多，看得多，卻說的少
senses.en: It seems to hear and see a lot, but to talk only a little.
